basic_profile.bio: Avid gamer and philosophy enthusiast living in the Pacific Northwest. I enjoy deep dives into video games, particularly RPGs like Demon's Souls and fighting games such as Under Night In-Birth. When I'm not gaming, you can find me exploring philosophical concepts like panpsychism. Currently working as a software developer with a passion for AI and machine learning. I volunteer at a local animal shelter on weekends, and I’m a proud foster parent to several cats. Usually online during late evenings after work, around 6 PM to midnight PST. In a long-term relationship with my partner who shares my love for gaming and philosophy.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a degree in Computer Science and have been working in the tech industry for over a decade. My interest in gaming and technology blossomed during my college years, and I have since honed my skills through both formal education and self-directed learning. I'm particularly knowledgeable about AI, machine learning, and the latest trends in game development.
